exposure: Antepartum ratio of soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 to placental growth factor
cohort: 988 consecutive women admitted to a tertiary medical center for cesarean section of a singleton pregnancy
finding: Postpartum hypertension was associated with a higher body mass index, history of diabetes mellitus, and a higher antepartum ratio of soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase 1 to placental growth factor.
